scale_numeric5_hint: Five steps. Enough room to separate values without agonising over each card.
scale_numeric10_hint: Ten steps. Finer distinctions, and a longer decision on every card.
scale_qualitative_hint: Three levels. The quickest way through the deck.
assessment_finish_partial: You can finish now — unrated values are simply left out of this record.
assessment_exit_message: Your answers so far are already saved. You can pick up where you left off.
assessment_recalibration_notice: You already calibrated today. Finishing overwrites that record.
assessment_new_record_notice: This will be saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_prefilled_notice: Starting from your last answers — change what has moved.
assessment_saved_new: Saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_no_values: There are no values in your deck. Restore some in Settings.
assessment_import_hint: Have a backup from another device? Load it here — the deck is not the only way in.
results_empty_body: Rate the value cards once and your ranking appears here.
results_row_hint: Point at a value — or tap it — to read what it means.
results_unrated_hint: {{count}} values were left unrated in this record.
history_empty_body: Your calibrations will be listed here as you record them.
history_needs_two_body: Recalibrate another day and this screen will show what moved.
history_nothing_moved: Nothing moved between these two calibrations.
history_grid_caption: One card per value — same timeline, same 0–100% scale, so the cards can be read against each other.
history_grid_caption_single: One card per value — where each one stands now, on a 0–100% scale.
history_compare_hint: Tap the plot to read every line at one calibration.
history_compare_empty: Tap up to {{count}} cards below to overlay their lines here.
history_delete_confirm_message: The record for {{date}} and all of its ratings are removed. This cannot be undone.
alignment_intro: The second list. For each value you called very important, how far does your behaviour match it right now? Ten rings: the centre is "my behaviour does not match this value", the outer edge is "I live fully in line with it".
alignment_outer_label: I live fully in accordance with my values
alignment_inner_label: My behaviour does not correspond to my values
alignment_empty_body: Rate the value cards once. The ones you call very important come here as a wheel to fill in.
alignment_none_body: The wheel fills up with whatever reaches the very top of your ranking, and nothing is there yet. It appears on its own the next time something does.
alignment_checked_today: Checked in today — filled in: {{rated}} of {{total}}.
alignment_not_checked_today: No check-in today yet. Answer one row and today is recorded.
alignment_previous_hint: The dotted outline is the check-in of {{date}} — filled in there: {{count}}.
alignment_sector_hint: Point at a sector — or tap one — to see which value it stands for.
alignment_row_hint: 1 is the centre of the wheel, 10 is the outer edge.
alignment_delete_confirm_message: The wheel recorded on {{date}} is removed. This cannot be undone.
alignment_viewing_body: A past wheel, drawn from what it recorded. Only today's can be answered.
settings_scale_notice: Applies to your next calibration. Records already taken keep their own scale.
settings_recalibrate_today: Today is already recorded — recalibrating overwrites it.
settings_recalibrate_past: Last calibration {{date}}. A new one today is saved as its own record.
settings_values_hint: {{active}} of {{total}} values are in the deck
update_hint: You're running version {{version}}. Updates are downloaded from GitHub releases.
update_available_body: A newer version is ready to download and install.
update_backing_up: Saving a copy of your records first…
update_download_failed: The update could not be downloaded. Please try again.
update_install_failed: The downloaded file could not be opened. Try downloading it again.
update_building_body: The release is published but its Android package isn't attached yet. Check back shortly.
update_building_elapsed: The build has been running for {{minutes}} min. Check back once it finishes.
update_error_rate_limited: GitHub is rate-limiting this network. Try again in an hour.
update_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach GitHub to check for updates.
values_deck_hint: Archived values stay in your past records but are not dealt in new calibrations.
backup_hint: Everything you have — your ranking and your wheel check-ins — saves as one CSV file, readable in any spreadsheet, and loads back in on another device.
backup_export_note: One file, everything in it: this ranking and your wheel check-ins.
backup_paste_hint: Or paste the contents of a CSV file here.
backup_export_empty_body: Finish a calibration, or fill in the wheel once, and it can be saved.
backup_invalid_title: That is not a backup file
backup_invalid_body: A backup needs a header row with kind, date, value_key and score. Files from older versions — records or check-ins — are read too.
backup_nothing_body: No usable rows were found in that file.
backup_confirm_note: A calibration or check-in you already have for the same date is replaced.
backup_done_none: Nothing could be loaded from that file.
sheets_hint: The same backup, kept as a spreadsheet in your own Google Drive — written when you press save, and read back the same way.
sheets_privacy_note: This is the only part of the app that talks to anything outside your device, and only while one of these buttons is working. The app can see the spreadsheet it created itself and nothing else in your Drive.
sheets_name_hint: What the file is called in your Google Drive. Point another device at the same name to reach the same backup.
sheets_missing_body: This app has not saved a spreadsheet called “{{name}}” yet. Save one first, or check the name — a spreadsheet you made yourself is not one the app can see.
sheets_nothing_body: No usable rows were found in that spreadsheet.
error_google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not configured in this build.
error_google_unavailable: Google’s sign-in could not be opened. Check the connection, and any script blocker.
error_google_offline: Google could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error_google_unauthorized: Google refused the request. Sign in again and retry.
error_google_failed: Google could not complete that request. Try again in a moment.
share_hint: The link carries this ranking inside it — nothing is uploaded and no account is involved. Anyone you send it to can read the ranking.
share_empty_body: Finish a calibration and it can be shared.
share_copied_body: Paste it wherever you like. It opens as a page anyone can read — no app needed.
share_manual_body: This browser would not let the app reach the clipboard. The whole link is in the box below the button.
share_include_alignment_hint: Your check-in of {{date}} travels in the link as well — how far you said your behaviour matches those values. Answers included: {{count}}. Off by default, and off again next time.
compare_note: Your latest calibration, read against the link. Nothing is saved and nothing of yours changes. Scores are compared across scales, so each side is shown in the words it was answered in.
compare_shared_count: You have both rated {{count}} of these values.
compare_shared_count_alignment: You have both checked in on {{count}} of these values.
compare_closeness: On those, your answers are {{percent}}% alike.
compare_both_core: Very important to both of you: {{count}}.
compare_no_overlap: There is nothing here you have both answered, so the list below is one side only.
compare_invite_body: Rate the deck once and your ranking appears beside theirs. This link is kept while you do it, and you come back to it at the end.
share_view_note: Someone sent you this ranking. It is theirs, it is not saved here, and nothing of yours has changed.
share_view_invalid_title: That link is not a shared ranking
share_view_invalid_body: There is nothing readable in it. Ask for the link again — and copy it whole.
share_view_corrupt_body: Part of it is missing, so the ranking cannot be read. Chat apps often break a long link across lines — ask for it again, and copy it in one piece.
share_view_unsupported_title: That link needs a newer version
share_view_unsupported_body: It was made by a newer version of this app than the one you are running. Update, then open the link again.
share_view_alignment_title: How far they live by them
reset_data_hint: Deletes every calibration and restores the default value deck.
reset_confirm_message: Every calibration and every value you added is deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage_memory_warning: This browser isn't keeping your data — it will be gone when you close the tab.
privacy_local_only_title: Your data stays on this computer
privacy_local_only: Everything you record is stored by this browser, on this computer. There is no account and no server behind this page — nothing you enter is ever sent anywhere.
purpose_note: Nothing here interprets your answers or hands back an insight, a type or a diagnosis. It records what you say matters — so all it can ever show you is what you said, and what changed since.
value_courage_desc: To be courageous or brave; to persist in the face of fear, threat or difficulty.
value_curiosity_desc: To be curious, open-minded and interested; to explore and discover.
value_adaptability_desc: To adjust and adapt readily to changing circumstances.
value_open_mindedness_desc: To think things through, see things from other points of view, and weigh evidence fairly.
value_patience_desc: To wait calmly for what I want.
value_self_awareness_desc: To be aware of my own thoughts, feelings and actions.
value_learning_desc: To keep growing, advancing or improving in knowledge, skills, character or life experience.
value_self_control_desc: To act in accordance with my own ideals.
value_connection_desc: To engage fully in whatever I am doing, and be fully present with others.
value_cooperation_desc: To be cooperative and collaborative with others.
value_friendliness_desc: To be friendly, companionable or agreeable towards others.
value_forgiveness_desc: To be forgiving towards myself or others.
value_intimacy_desc: To open up, reveal and share myself, emotionally or physically.
value_love_desc: To act lovingly or affectionately towards myself or others.
value_respect_desc: To be respectful towards myself and others; to be considerate and show positive regard.
value_diligence_desc: To be industrious, hard-working and dedicated.
value_persistence_desc: To continue resolutely, despite problems or difficulties.
value_mastery_desc: To continually practise and improve my skills, and apply myself fully when using them.
value_acceptance_desc: To be open to and accepting of myself, others, and life.
value_health_desc: To maintain or improve my fitness; to look after my physical and mental health and wellbeing.
value_humour_desc: To be fun-loving; to seek, create and engage in fun-filled activities.
value_mindfulness_desc: To be conscious of, open to and curious about my here-and-now experience.
value_sensuality_desc: To create, explore and enjoy experiences that stimulate the five senses.
value_sexuality_desc: To explore or express my sexuality.
value_caring_desc: To be caring towards myself, others, and the environment.
value_compassion_desc: To act with kindness towards myself and others who are suffering.
value_generosity_desc: To contribute, help, assist, share and make a positive difference to myself or others.
value_encouragement_desc: To encourage and reward behaviour that I value in myself or others.
value_kindness_desc: To be kind, considerate, nurturing or caring towards myself or others.
value_helping_desc: To be supportive, helpful and available to myself or others.
value_equality_desc: To treat others as equal to myself, and vice versa.
value_reciprocity_desc: To build relationships in which there is a fair balance of giving and taking.
value_adventure_desc: To be adventurous; to actively seek, create, or explore novel or stimulating experiences.
value_assertiveness_desc: To respectfully stand up for my rights and request what I want.
value_freedom_desc: To live freely; to choose how I live and behave, or help others do likewise.
value_excitement_desc: To seek, create and engage in activities that are exciting, stimulating or thrilling.
value_honesty_desc: To be honest, truthful and sincere with myself and others.
value_responsibility_desc: To be responsible and accountable for my actions.
value_safety_desc: To secure, protect or ensure the safety of myself or others.
value_conformity_desc: To be respectful and obedient of rules and obligations.
value_trustworthiness_desc: To be trustworthy; to be loyal, faithful, sincere and reliable.
value_authenticity_desc: To be authentic, genuine and real; to be true to myself.
value_gratitude_desc: To be grateful for and appreciative of myself, others and life.
value_humility_desc: To be humble or modest; to let my achievements speak for themselves.
value_spirituality_desc: To connect with things bigger than myself.
